narrativeAuthority.headline: A professional digital showroom for every business.

en-US.title: MirtPage
en-US.shortDescription: Explore business digital showrooms. Choose products and ask directly.
en-US.fullDescription:
MirtPage gives every business a professional digital showroom. Explore what it sells, makes or grows, with its brand, story, product range and listed availability in one organized place—without digging through social posts.

For customers
Explore retailers, workshops, factories, farms and suppliers. Search for products or find businesses on the map, with category, country and city filters. Open a showroom to browse photos, descriptions and the choices a business offers.

See listed availability and whether a product is ready to ship or made to order. Choose the items that interest you, then open a contact channel the business has set up. Your inquiry and selected product links are ready to paste. You can also copy the message to share another way.

For businesses
Give what you sell, make or grow a showroom worth sharing. Bring your name, story and product range together, organize optional collections and share one link. Start with a private sample page, replace it with your own content and publish when ready. Customers explore your range and contact you through your chosen social channels.

Transport and shipment plans
Ask our transport team for help by chat. In the separate Tracking area, verify your email with a code to view the shipment plans addressed to you. See the route stages the team has entered, including plans for more than one shipment.

Availability is information listed by each business. Confirm the product details and agree your order directly with that business. Shipment plans describe the route stages entered by the team.

Use MirtPage in English, Amharic or Afaan Oromo.

am.title: MirtPage
am.shortDescription: የንግዱን ታሪክና ምርቶች በዲጂታል ማሳያው ይወቁ፤ ከንግዱም በቀጥታ ይጠይቁ።
am.fullDescription:
ለእያንዳንዱ ንግድ የተደራጀ ዲጂታል ማሳያ ገጽ። ንግዶች የሚሸጡትን፣ የሚሠሩትንና የሚያበቅሉትን ይመልከቱ። ምርቶቻቸውን፣ ስብስቦቻቸውን፣ አማራጮቻቸውንና ታሪካቸውን፣ ስለ ምርት አቅርቦት ካስቀመጡት መረጃ ጋር በአንድ ቦታ ያግኙ። የቆዩ የማኅበራዊ ሚዲያ ልጥፎችን ሳይፈትሹ፣ የፈለጉትን መርጠው ንግዱን በቀጥታ ያነጋግሩ።

ለደንበኞች
ከሱቅና ከወርክሾፕ እስከ ፋብሪካ፣ እርሻና አቅራቢ፣ የተለያዩ ንግዶችን ያግኙ። ምርት ይፈልጉ፤ ንግዶችን በካርታ ይመልከቱ። በምድብ፣ በሀገርና በከተማ ያጣሩ። የንግዱን ማሳያ ከፍተው ፎቶዎችን፣ መግለጫዎችንና የቀረቡ ምርጫዎችን ይመልከቱ።

ምርቱ ለመላክ ዝግጁ መሆኑን ወይም በትዕዛዝ የሚሠራ መሆኑን ንግዱ ባስቀመጠው መረጃ ይወቁ። የሚፈልጉትን እቃ መርጠው ንግዱ ያስመዘገበውን የማኅበራዊ ሚዲያ አድራሻ ይክፈቱ። የጥያቄ መልዕክቱና የተመረጡ ምርቶች ሊንኮች ለመለጠፍ ይዘጋጃሉ። በሌላ መንገድ ለመላክም መልዕክቱን መቅዳት ይችላሉ።

ለንግድ ባለቤቶች
የሚሸጡትን፣ የሚሠሩትን ወይም የሚያበቅሉትን በራስዎ ዲጂታል ማሳያ ያቅርቡ። ስምዎን፣ ታሪክዎንና ምርቶችዎን አንድ ላይ ያስቀምጡ፤ ከፈለጉ በስብስብ ያደራጁና አንድ ሊንክ ያጋሩ። በግል የምሳሌ ገጽ ይጀምሩ፤ በራስዎ መረጃ ተክተው ሲዘጋጁ ያሳትሙ። ደንበኞች ምርቶቹን አይተው እርስዎ በመረጡት የማኅበራዊ ሚዲያ መንገድ ያነጋግሩዎታል።

ማጓጓዣና የጭነት ዕቅድ
ማጓጓዣ ለማመቻቸት ከቡድናችን ጋር በቻት ይነጋገሩ። በተለየው የጭነት መከታተያ ውስጥ በኢሜይል የተላከውን ኮድ በማስገባት ለእርስዎ የተዘጋጁ የጭነት ዕቅዶችን ይመልከቱ። ለእያንዳንዱ ጭነት ቡድኑ ያስቀመጣቸውን የጉዞ ደረጃዎች ማየት ይችላሉ።

ስለምርት መገኘት መረጃውን የሚያስቀምጠው ንግዱ ነው። ዝርዝሩን ከንግዱ ያረጋግጡ፤ ትዕዛዙንም በቀጥታ በመነጋገር ያመቻቹ። የጭነት ዕቅዱ ቡድኑ ያስገባቸውን የጉዞ ደረጃዎች ያሳያል።

MirtPageን በእንግሊዝኛ፣ በአማርኛ ወይም በአፋን ኦሮሞ ይጠቀሙ።

om.title: MirtPage
om.shortDescription: Daldalaa fi oomisha isaa bakka tokkotti ilaali; kallattiin gaafadhu.
om.fullDescription:
Daldala hundaaf fuula agarsiisa dijitaalaa sirnaan qophaa’e. Oomishaalee dhaabbileen daldalaa gurguran, hojjetan yookaan qonnaan oomishan ilaalaa. Oomishaalee, walitti qabama, filannoowwan fi seenaa isaanii, akkasumas odeeffannoo argamuu oomishaa isaan ibsan bakka tokkootti argadhaa. Maxxansa miidiyaa hawaasaa keessa osoo hin barbaadin, waan isin barbaachisu filadhaa; ergasii dhaabbaticha kallattiin quunnamaa.

Maamiltootaaf
Suqiiwwan, warshaalee xixiqqaa, warshaalee gurguddaa, qonnaan bultootaa fi dhiyeessitoota ilaali. Oomisha barbaadi ykn daldala kaartaa irratti argadhu. Gosa, biyya fi magaalaadhaan calali. Suuraa, ibsa fi filannoowwan daldalichi dhiyeessu bakka tokkotti ilaali.

Oomishni erguuf qophaa'aa ta'uu ykn ajaja irratti hojjetamuu isaa odeeffannoo daldalichi kaa'e irraa ilaali. Wantoota si barbaachisan filadhu; karaa miidiyaa hawaasaa daldalichi galche bani. Ergaan gaaffii kee fi liinkii oomishaalee filatamanii maxxansuuf qophaa'u. Karaa biraatiin erguufis ergaa sana waraabuu dandeessa.

Abbootii daldalaaf
Waan gurgurtu, hojjettu ykn oomishtuu bakka agarsiisa dijitaalaa mataa keetii irratti dhiyeessi. Maqaa, seenaa fi oomishaalee kee walitti fidi. Yoo barbaadde tuuta tuutaan qindeessi; liinkii tokko qoodi. Fuula fakkeenyaa dhuunfaa irraa jalqabi; odeeffannoo mataa keetiin bakka buusiitii yeroo qophooftu maxxansi. Maamiltoonni oomishaalee kee ilaalanii karaa miidiyaa hawaasaa ati filatteen si quunnamu.

Geejjibaa fi karoora fe'umsaa
Gargaarsa geejjibaaf garee keenya karaa chaatii gaafadhu. Kutaa Tracking adda ta'e keessatti koodii imeeliidhaan siif ergamu galchuun karoora fe'umsaa siif qophaa'e ilaali. Fe'umsa tokkoo ol irratti sadarkaalee imalaa gareen galche arguu dandeessa.

Odeeffannoo argama oomishaa kan kaa'u daldalicha. Ibsa isaa mirkaneeffadhu; ajaja kee daldalicha waliin kallattiin irratti walii gali. Karoora fe'umsaa keessatti kan mul'atu sadarkaalee imalaa gareen galche dha.

MirtPage Afaan Ingiliffaa, Amaariffaa fi Afaan Oromootiin fayyadami.

featureClaims.qualification: Business-listed information; customers confirm details directly.
External configured contact channels, prepared copy and manual copy; no customer-to-business inbox inside MirtPage.
Help by chat; no instant response, booking, price or delivery promise.
Email-code-authorized shipment plans and entered route stages; no GPS, scan event or delivery-completion claim.
